name: Date picker
looksLike: small calendar where I choose a day
field that opens a grid of dates
month and numbered days with one day highlighted
definition: A field for choosing a date, often with a calendar popup and a way to enter the date directly.

notConfusedWith.difference: Chooses from general options rather than calendar dates.

prompts.short: Add a labeled date picker with keyboard input and a visible selected date.
prompts.detailed: Add a native date input with an associated label and visible focus. Explain any date limits and show errors beside the field. Preserve keyboard entry, give the input a 44px target, and avoid forcing users to navigate a custom calendar for distant dates.

html: <input id="due-date" name="dueDate" type="date" aria-describedby="due-date-help" style="min-height:44px; width:100%; box-sizing:border-box">
Choose the day this task should be finished.
vue: Choose the day this task should be finished.
a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; }

a11yNotes: Associate a visible label and any help or error text
Allow keyboard entry and preserve visible focus
For custom calendars, manage focus and announce dates and month changes
